# kubernetes_service_account_issuer

This data source reads the OpenID Connect JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) published by the Kubernetes API server and exposes both the raw payload and a parsed key list.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `issuer` (String) OIDC issuer as reported by the cluster OpenID configuration.
- `jwks_uri` (String) jwks_uri as reported by the cluster OpenID configuration.
- `jwks_raw` (String) Raw JSON payload returned from /openid/v1/jwks
- `jwks_keys` (List of Map of String) List of JWKS keys as string maps.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kubernetes_service_account_issuer" "aws-oidc" {}

resource "aws_s3_object" "keys-json" {
  bucket       = aws_s3_bucket.aws-oidc.id
  key          = "keys.json"
  content      = data.kubernetes_service_account_issuer.aws-oidc.jwks_raw // jsonencode(local.keys_json)
  acl          = "public-read"
  content_type = "application/json"
}
```
